vision.name: Sinister Choke
vision.text:
[Attack] Physical attack.
Damage from this attack cannot be prevented. This attack cannot be stopped and its damage is banished if your opponent controls a total of 7 or more of the following card types: personalities, Drills, Setups, and Dragon Balls.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
(Banish after use.)
vision.review: never officially released: image is overlaid with 'NEVER OFFICIALLY RELEASED' and most text is hidden. Text shown is copied from the card it reprints (S04 #139); visible fragments match, but exact wording on this printing is unconfirmed
vision.note: low-res, overlaid image. The overlaid image also shows "(Dragon Prix 2017)" at the bottom of the text box.
